title: Bumper: Correction
mood: sober: a rewind, then the motif backwards, resolving calmly
description: Segment bumper for Correction, built from Zoo's motif (3.4 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change: the file starts with two frames of silence, so start it at downbeatStartFrame(cue, cutFrame) (2 frames early). The music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: Sober: a reversed piano swell (the rewind) runs straight into the motif played backwards, resolving to D minor. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the bus cut moved to 650 Hz (-4.5 dB) and the rewind is narrower (width 0.7): boxiness 0.7 dB (3.4 before), mono loss 1.0 dB and a windowed correlation minimum of +0.20 (1.5 dB and -0.05 before). It is still normalised to the same -16 LUFS-I as the other bumpers (the critic's optional -17 was not applied: the set stays level-matched); it loses 5.5 LU on the phone model, about what Zoo's voice loses. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): release-ready; re-rendered with the shared fixes (measured tuning, the decaying FingerBass, one kick tuning, the band compressors, the -1.5 dBTP sting ceiling). Master limiter 0.00 dB at most; -3.4 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten), -3.7 dBTP after Opus 128k.
